title: check-governed-queue-guard: a PR landed from a project thread needs a review of record whose Reviewed-by session belongs to a different account from the PR's attribution github_login, else Tier S does not enqueue (maintainer's word 2026-10-23)
body:
Filing gate **③**: a maintainer-direct task, the maintainer's words quoted verbatim. Filed from the Claude Code project "Objectstack" (account `os-elon-musk`) by the research thread 车队机制迁往 Projects on the maintainer's word there. ⛔ Not a claim. Lane self-applied under exception 二; grade suggested p2 · S; triage may regrade.

**Reader (who acts):** the `domain:devx` seat 1 (seat post #6023), as an in-seat subagent S card on `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (+ `record-recognisers.mjs` if the account line needs a reader). Not `.claude/**`; ordinary queue landing. Pairs with the skills card that writes the rule into `contract-review.md`; this card enforces it.
## The maintainer's words (2026-10-23, project thread 车队机制迁往 Projects, verbatim)

> 我的账户清单不固定的， 20x 周流量用完了，我就会换另外一个账户。 (06:27Z)
> 具体的分配应该是我人工制定的。 (06:27Z)
> 元数据项目应该各自分诊，但是决裁可以统一报总监。 (06:32Z)
> 管理者不是 bill 是 hotlong / 或者你不要强调是谁 (11:45Z, 11:46Z)
> 全项目并发上限 6 (11:46Z)
> 分诊不忙不如留给总监管 (12:08Z)
> 如果我同意这一整套机制，相关的 skills 是不是都要修改，文件应该落在仓库中 (12:10Z)
> 你立卡并派发处理所有相关任务，跟踪落地 (12:13Z)

The research memo these cards implement: https://claude.ai/artifact/VFTHWcmKkzbah17UM8KRqm (sections 6, 10–13; private to the maintainer's account).

## What was measured

- The guard already requires a `## Contract review` record on the current head carrying a `Reviewed-by:` line and a standing `Served-tier:` (`check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` L263–L303). It does not read whose session that is.
- A project thread's PR body line 1 is `<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"<login>"} -->` (see #25220); the relay comment's author is always `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so the account is only in that line and in the relay log's sender.
- On #25363 the record's independence paragraph named both accounts in prose (6357150459); nothing machine-read it.

## Wanted

- When the PR body carries the attribution line, the review of record must carry a `Reviewed-by-account:` key line (or an equivalent the skills card settles on) whose login ≠ the attribution login; equal or absent ⇒ the Tier S enqueue leg is refused with a prescription naming both logins and the rule. PRs without an attribution line (Routine seats, humans) keep today's behaviour.
- Self-test cases: equal logins refused; different logins pass; missing account line on an attributed PR refused; unattributed PR unchanged.
- `--pair` landing pre-check prints the two logins it compared.

## Acceptance

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` green with the new cases; the workflow that runs the guard is unchanged.
- `--explain` on #25363's head (historical) shows what the verdict would have been.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, "governed queue guard reviewer account must differ from PR author attribution github_login independence check" → 39 hits; top: #25199 (closed, objectui Tier S route), #25220 (open, attribution line exemption — this card READS that line), #18382, #18020 (closed), #18068 (closed, write-identity locks: 「user accounts limited to assignee and approval」 — the invariant this card enforces mechanically), #15187, #11083, #8161 (closed, GitHub forbids self-approval), #25364, #25070. None compares the reviewer's account to the author's. **New.**

Dedupe words: `queue guard Reviewed-by account ≠ attribution login`.
